description: In frame 0, the black-masked participant reaches their right arm across to the lower-left corner of the table touching a dark box with a fiducial marker; in frames 1-2 the participant stands upright with arms by their torso while the dark box sits on the left, and in frame 3 Baxter's left gripper enters from the lower left above the dark box.

In frames 0-2, Baxter's left arm is positioned at the far left edge above a white-and-red box, a gray fiducial-tagged box, and a yellow object; in frame 3, Baxter's left gripper swings inward horizontally above the gray and yellow objects while the black-masked participant watches.

In frames 0-2, Baxter's left gripper holds a tilted white-and-red box and blue block at the far left above a gray box and yellow fiducial object; in frame 3, the left gripper extends horizontally inward toward the center-left of the table while the black-masked participant stands facing the workspace.

In frames 0-2, Baxter's left gripper holds a blue block and a tilted purple carton at the left above a yellow object, a dark fiducial-tagged box, and a white flat plate; in frame 3, the left arm moves lower and horizontally over the dark box and yellow object while the black-masked participant watches.

Baxter's left gripper holds a dark rectangular box on a blue tray above the left side of the table across all 4 frames; the black-masked participant stands with their right hand raised to their head in frames 0-2, then lowers their right arm toward the left side of the table in frame 3.

In frames 0-2, the tabletop is bare except for white tape markers on the left and the tablet on the right while the black-masked participant stands looking toward the left; in frame 3, Baxter's left gripper enters at the lower left carrying a white-and-red object over the tape markers.

In frames 0-2, a white-and-red box, a gray box, and a yellow fiducial-tagged object rest on the left side of the table while the black-masked participant stands with hands near their waist; in frame 3, Baxter's left gripper enters horizontally above the white-and-red box.

A dark box with a white fiducial marker sits on the lower-left corner of the table and a white tablet rests on the center-right across all 4 frames; the black-masked participant stands facing the workspace in frames 0-2, and in frame 3 Baxter's left gripper enters at the lower left above the dark box.

A dark box with a white fiducial marker sits on the lower-left tape markers across all 4 frames; the black-masked participant leans forward looking toward the left in frames 0-2, then straightens up in frame 3 as Baxter's left gripper enters at the lower left above the dark box.

Under cooler blue-tinted lighting, a dark box with a white fiducial marker rests on the lower-left tape markers across all 4 frames while the black-masked participant stands with hands behind/near their waist; in frame 3, Baxter's left gripper enters at the lower left above the dark box.
